title: DocuSearch - Enterprise RAG Assistant with Agentic AI
description: Built an enterprise-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) assistant capable of answering questions over PDFs, documentation, and internal knowledge bases. Combined vector databases, semantic search, and LLMs with agent workflows for reasoning, tool calling, citation generation, and multi-document retrieval.

title: DesignBase | AI Powered Database Schema Designer and Validator
description: Ideated, designed and built an AI-powered database design system that converts natural-language business requirements into validated relational schemas, SQL DDL, relationship diagrams, and security recommendations.

title: Semantic Movie Recommendation System (Netflix-Style AI Recommender)
description: Built an intelligent movie recommendation system that understands semantic meaning instead of relying on keyword matching. Leverages Sentence Transformers embeddings and similarity search to recommend movies based on plot descriptions, themes, and user-selected titles. Developed with FastAPI and Jinja2 to deliver a responsive Netflix-inspired web interface.

title: Marketing Campaign A/B Testing
description: Conducted an A/B Test to analyze the conversion rates between Ad and PSA groups. A Two Proportions Z-test was used for the experiment.

title: Brain Tumor Detection using Machine Learning
description: Developed a brain tumor classification system trained on medical imaging data using multiple machine learning algorithms, including XGBoost and Scikit-learn models. Built an interactive Streamlit application that allows users to upload MRI scans and receive real-time predictions with an intuitive interface.

title: Road Potholes Detection, Mapping and Management System
description: Designed a Pothole detection system using pretrained YOLO V8 detection model. Used XML tree and OpenCV to map the detected labels for training. Recall 0.736.
